name: CheapCarRent search
tagline: Search live car rental offers from local rental companies.
description: Read-only remote MCP server for CheapCarRent. Tools: list_locations (pickup cities and airports) and search_cars (live offers). Covers 15,000 pickup points in 46 countries. Streamable HTTP at https://cheapcarent.com/mcp, no authentication. The server does not book, take payment, or accept personal data. Official MCP Registry: com.cheapcarent/search v1.0.2. Docs: https://cheapcarent.com/developers.
